claim: In 1753 a monastic mission from Ayutthaya led by Upali Thera, supported by Kirti Sri Rajasinghe and Weliwita Saranankara, restored higher ordination in Kandy and established the institutional basis of the Siam Nikaya.
bounded_by: This closes the mission and ordination event, not the later social reach, caste boundaries or uniformity of the order.
notes: Supports a Kandy-to-Ayutthaya dezoom: religious centrality was rebuilt through a transregional Theravada network.
